Class BigNumberedMap<K extends edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.Numbered, V>

java.lang.Object
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.BigMap<K,V>
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.BigNumberedMap<K,V>
Type Parameters:
K - the type of unique numbered key associated with values in this map
V - the type of element associated with the keys
All Implemented Interfaces:
Iterable<Entry<K,V>>
public class BigNumberedMap<K extends edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.Numbered, V> extends BigMap<K,V>
A map that uses numbered story graph elements as keys and stores values in an array list indexed by the key's ID number. This map takes less memory than a hash map and guarantees constant time access to entries; however, it may not work when the ID numbers of keys change, such as during graph pruning.
Author:
Stephen G. Ware

    • put

      public void put(K key, V value)
      Maps the given key to the given value, possibly overriding the previous mapping if the key already exists in the map.

      The key must be an object of the list of keys this map was constructed with.

      This map does not distinguish between a key having no value and having null as its value. Settings a key to null effectively removes it and reduces the size of the map.

      Specified by:
      put in class BigMap<K extends edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.Numbered, V>
      Parameters:
      key - the key to be associated with the value
      value - the value to associate with the key
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the given key is not in this map's set of keys
